description: The current details of a data sink run linked to an alert, not a snapshot of the original failure. It names the data sink and the run, never a user, a destination or a credential. Status, attempts and reason reflect the run's current state.

attempts.description: The run's current number of failed attempts.
attempts.title: attempts

backfillID.description: The backfill of the run, for a Backfill run.
backfillID.title: backfillID

dataSinkID.description: The ID of the data sink.
dataSinkID.title: dataSinkID

dataSinkName.description: The current name of the data sink, or its ID if the sink was deleted.
dataSinkName.title: dataSinkName

dataset.description: The dataset of the run, using the same values as DataSinkRun.dataset.
dataset.title: dataset

kind.description: The kind of the run, using the same values as DataSinkRun.kind.
kind.title: kind

reason.description: The run's current safe error message, cleared when execution resumes.
reason.title: reason

runID.description: The runID of the linked DataSinkRun.
runID.title: runID

status.description: The current status of the linked run, using the DataSinkRun status values.
status.title: status

timestamp.description: When the linked run was last updated.
timestamp.title: timestamp

title: AlertDataSinkEvent
